_comment_base_url: Full base URL for OpenAI-compatible API (include /v1 if needed). Examples: 'http://localhost:8080/v1' for LiteLLM, 'http://localhost:11434/v1' for Ollama
_comment_api_key: API key for LLM endpoint. Use 'dummy' for local models without auth. For API providers, use your actual key.
_comment_ssl: Path to SSL certificate bundle file (e.g., '/etc/ssl/certs/ca-bundle.crt' or '~/certificates/ca-bundle.crt'). Leave empty to use system default. Automatically sets SSL_CERT_FILE environment variable.
_comment_retrieval: Retrieval parameters (can be overridden by web UI controls)
_comment_llm: LLM parameters (can be overridden by web UI controls)
_comment_ui: Web UI controls provide runtime overrides with higher priority:
_comment_ui_1: - Response Style selector sets temperature and deep_dive mode
_comment_ui_4: Priority: Web UI > Response Style > config.json > code defaults
